# Setu Digital Solutions

> Setu Digital Solutions is a business technology partner based in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, specializing in Tally Prime customization, TDL (Tally Definition Language) development, ERP & API integration, web & mobile business applications (SetuLink, eDocSuite, Setu AI), and industry-specific Tally ERP modules.

## Core Services
- **Tally Customization & TDL Development**: Bespoke TDL modules, custom GST invoice print formats, role-based approval workflows, voucher automation, and specialized accounting/inventory controls for Tally Prime.
- **ERP & API Integration**: Two-way integration connecting Tally Prime with ERP platforms, CRM software, e-commerce portals, billing software, and external REST/JSON/XML APIs to eliminate repetitive manual data entry.
- **Web & Mobile Business Applications**: Custom web dashboards and mobile portals for field teams, remote order booking, live customer ledger access, and connected multi-branch workflows.
- **MIS & Business Reports**: Executive financial summaries, receivables ageing, cash-flow tracking, cost-center performance, and automated MIS reporting.
- **Solution Implementation & Training**: Requirement discovery, workflow configuration, deployment, and practical department-wise staff training.
- **Support & Consulting**: Ongoing technical assistance, troubleshooting, and continuous business system improvements.
- **Bulk SMS & Bulk WhatsApp Messaging (CPaaS)**: Communications Platform as a Service for promotional and transactional Bulk SMS (with DLT support), Bulk WhatsApp campaigns with PDFs/invoices, automated OTPs, payment reminders, and Tally/API messaging integration.

## Featured Digital Products
- **SetuLink**: Web and mobile field-force application that connects sales and collection teams with Tally Prime for live customer ledger viewing, outstanding tracking, remote sales order booking, payment receipt entry, and instant PDF/WhatsApp sharing.
- **eDocSuite**: Digital document management software that attaches, organizes, and retrieves supporting invoices, bills, transport bilty, and contracts directly alongside Tally business records.
- **Setu AI**: Business intelligence and analytics platform that transforms Tally Prime accounting and inventory data into clear trends, KPIs, anomaly alerts, and executive summaries.

## Specialized Industry Solutions
- Transport & Fleet Management
